source_manifest.selection: ascending sha256(seed:id), then id; independently per preserved split

notes.test: The official fullwiki test split has no answer labels, so the labeled official validation split is reserved as the final test partition instead.
notes.dev: The tuning split is 1/10 of official train, ordered by sha256('0:' + id) so the partition is reproducible and disjoint from train. Row order within each split follows the official files.

train.origin: official train, minus the derived dev holdout

test.origin: official labeled validation, held out in full
